extension.name: ToothOps for ezyVet
extension.description: Writes your ToothOps record notes into the open ezyVet consult.

install.title: The ToothOps for ezyVet extension isn’t responding
install.body: Make sure the ToothOps for ezyVet extension is installed and enabled in Chrome, then try again. If you don’t have it yet, contact ToothOps support for the install link.

noTab: Open the consult in ezyVet, then try again.
severalTabs: Several ezyVet tabs are open. Using: {{title}}

state.notConsult: The ezyVet tab isn’t showing a consult. Open the patient’s consult, then try again.
state.notMedicalTab: Open the Medical tab of the consult, then try again.
state.locked: This consult is locked in ezyVet. Open an unlocked consult, then try again.
state.combined: ezyVet is in Combined view. Switch to Standard view, then try again.

editedNotice: The note was edited, so it can’t be split back into its sections. It will be sent as one block.

actions.diagnosticCopied: Diagnostic report copied. Paste it into your message to ToothOps support.

mismatch.title: Different patient?
mismatch.messageNumbers: The chart is for {{chart}} (number {{chartNumber}}), but ezyVet shows {{ezyvet}} (number {{ezyvetNumber}}).

alreadySent.title: Already sent on {{date}}. Send again?
alreadySent.message: Sending again adds a second copy in ezyVet.

results.title: Results
results.stampFailed: Sent, but ToothOps couldn’t record the send date on this chart.

errors.extension_error: ToothOps couldn’t reach the ezyVet extension. Check that it is installed and enabled, then try again.
errors.timeout: The extension didn’t answer in time. Check the ezyVet tab and try again.
errors.no_tab: The ezyVet tab was closed. Open the consult in ezyVet and try again.
errors.not_writable: The consult can’t be written to any more (locked, closed or no longer on the Medical tab). Open the consult’s Medical tab and try again.
errors.patient_changed: A different patient or consult is now open in ezyVet, so nothing more was sent. Open the right consult and try again.
errors.field_not_found: This field isn’t on the consult page. Choose another field under Where it goes.
errors.editor_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find this field’s text box. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_found: This field’s editing window didn’t open. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_closed: This field’s editing window didn’t close after saving. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.save_button_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find the Save button for this field. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.save_not_confirmed: ezyVet didn’t confirm the save. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.no_preferred_email: The client has no preferred email address in ezyVet. Add one, or choose another field.
errors.image_not_accepted: This field doesn’t accept pictures. Choose Discharge Summary or another field that does.
errors.invalid_image: The chart picture couldn’t be prepared. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.picture_failed: ToothOps couldn’t draw the chart picture, so it wasn’t sent.
errors.maybe_sent: Some fields may already have been written. Check the consult in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.item_extension_error: Something went wrong while writing this field. Check the field in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.item_not_writable: The consult stopped accepting changes (locked, closed or no longer on the Medical tab), so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in ezyVet before sending again.
errors.item_patient_changed: A different patient or consult was opened in ezyVet, so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in ezyVet before sending again.

panel.notConnected: This build isn’t connected to ToothOps.

signIn.title: Sign in to ToothOps
signIn.lead: Send record notes from your ToothOps charts into the open ezyVet consult.

list.matchCount: {{matches}} charts match this patient. Showing the most recent.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by patient, owner or number

chart.flagLoading: Checking whether sending is on for your practice…
chart.flagFailed: Couldn’t check whether sending to ezyVet is turned on for your practice.
chart.sendOff: Sending to ezyVet isn’t turned on for your practice.

today.title: Today’s patients (ezyVet)
today.loadHint: This switches your ezyVet tab to the calendar.
today.noTab: Open ezyVet to see today’s patients.
today.empty: No patients on today’s ezyVet schedule.

errors.no_date_input: Couldn’t set the date on ezyVet’s calendar.
errors.no_calendar_refresh: ezyVet’s calendar didn’t respond. Reload ezyVet and try again.

send.targetChanged: The ezyVet consult changed. Check the target and press Send again.

handover.filled: Patient details filled in from ezyVet.
handover.failed: Couldn’t get the patient from ezyVet. Fill in the details.
handover.otherUser: This patient was picked in the extension as another user. Sign in with the same account in both.
